title: Hardship Settlement Pricing Schedule: Stage Floors, Offer Percentage and Settlement Amount
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Pricing Schedule

## Schedule

The Hardship Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements is priced from two floors per placement stage. The Hardship Settlement authority floor for the account's current placement stage is 100.0 for Early-Out Placement, 55.0 for Primary Placement, 40.0 for Secondary Placement, 30.0 for Tertiary Placement, 25.0 for Warehouse Placement and 60.0 for Legal Review Placement, and the Hardship Settlement approval floor for the same stages is 100.0, 40.0, 30.0, 20.0, 15.0 and 45.0 in that order.

| Current placement stage | Authority floor | Approval floor |
|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | 100.0 | 100.0 |
| Primary Placement | 55.0 | 40.0 |
| Secondary Placement | 40.0 | 30.0 |
| Tertiary Placement | 30.0 | 20.0 |
| Warehouse Placement | 25.0 | 15.0 |
| Legal Review Placement | 60.0 | 45.0 |

## Percentage

The Hardship Settlement offer percentage is the Hardship Settlement authority floor for the stage, never set below the Hardship Settlement approval floor for the stage.

The Hardship Settlement offer percentage is worked out in this order: first the Hardship Settlement authority floor for the stage is taken, then every Hardship Settlement reduction that applies is added together and subtracted from it once, and only then is that figure compared with the Hardship Settlement approval floor for the stage, the higher of the two being the Hardship Settlement offer percentage.

The Hardship Settlement offer percentage is carried to one decimal place and the settlement amount is computed from it.

## Amount

The Hardship Settlement amount is the account's balance due on the offer date times the Hardship Settlement offer percentage divided by 100, rounded up to the next whole dollar only once at the end; an amount below 50.00 dollars is never offered under this rule.

A Hardship Settlement offer under this rule never relies on a client approval: it is extended only where the account's balance due is no more than 15,000.00 dollars and the balance due less the settlement amount is no more than 12,500.00 dollars, and it carries no approval request.

## Worked examples on hypothetical balances

| Stage | Balance due on the offer date | Offer percentage | Before rounding | Hardship Settlement amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secondary Placement | 3210.00 dollars | 40.0 | 1284.00 | 1284.00 dollars |
| Primary Placement | 999.99 dollars | 55.0 | 549.9945 | 550.00 dollars |
| Tertiary Placement | 150.00 dollars | 30.0 | 45.00 | below 50.00 dollars, not offered under this rule |

In the first row the balance less the amount is 1926.00 dollars, within the 12,500.00-dollar limit.
